0022600220.text: The Chicago Bulls, 1-8 overall and 0-3 at home, host the San Antonio Spurs in their 10th game of the season. The Bulls sit fourth in the Central, five games back, and 14th in the East, while the Spurs, 8-2 and winners of eight straight, are first in the Southwest and third in the West. Chicago is missing Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and San Antonio is without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bulls lost both games to the Spurs in 2025-26, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30.
